rows.description: A young professional weighs a city job against returning home to family land or a small town. Neither is a failure; the choice depends on values, opportunities and what the person can give and get.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A toddler in a family relocating for a job notices packed boxes and stressed adults, and clings more. Familiar objects and routines give security in a strange new place.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child changing schools after a family move struggles with accents, syllabus and making friends. Feeling out of place is common; a kind classmate and a steady home routine help most.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teenager stays with grandparents while a parent works abroad or in another city, and misses them while knowing why they left. Regular calls and honest talk stop loneliness turning into resentment.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A young adult moves to a hostel in another city, thrilled by freedom and homesick at night. Building routines, friendships and regular calls home makes the shift steady.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A student shares a small room with strangers, handles food, laundry and money alone for the first time. Mistakes here are lessons, and asking for help is a strength, not a failure.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A young worker in a distant city sends part of a salary to parents or siblings and feels pride and heavy duty together. Talking openly about how much is sustainable prevents quiet resentment.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A parent at home lights up at a call, hides loneliness, and says nothing to avoid burdening the child. The young adult can read this quiet longing and call regularly or plan visits.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22
possibly related concept (heuristic): Yearning and longing

rows.description: A young adult moving abroad meets new food, rules and loneliness, and feels both free and unrooted. Building local friendships while keeping ties home makes a steadier life.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.subtopic: Honour and shame vs guilt cultures
rows.description: A child is warned that a mistake will make the neighbours talk and learns to fear public embarrassment before understanding right and wrong. Shame teaches quickly and often teaches fear rather than conscience.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: fear, shame, embarrassment
